intents.name: Payment Issue
intents.description: Customer has trouble making a payment or payment failed
exemplars: My payment didn't go through and I don't know why
I keep getting an error when trying to pay my bill online
The payment was declined but my card works everywhere else
I was double charged on my last payment
My autopay didn't process this month and now I have a late fee

intents.name: Billing Inquiry
intents.description: Customer wants to understand charges or billing details
exemplars: Can you explain these charges on my bill?
Why is my bill higher than usual this month?
I don't recognize a $15 charge on my statement
When is my next payment due?
How do I read my billing statement?

intents.name: Refund Request
intents.description: Customer requests a refund for charges or services
exemplars: I want a refund for the service outage last week
I was overcharged and need my money back
I cancelled within the trial period and was still charged
I need a refund because the product didn't work as advertised
Can I get a credit for the days my service was down?
I want my money back for the 3 days everything was completely down
I deserve a refund since my internet was out for a whole week
Give me a credit for the time my service wasn't working

intents.name: Plan Change
intents.description: Customer wants to modify their billing plan
exemplars: I want to switch to a cheaper plan
Can I upgrade my plan without changing my billing date?
What happens to my current balance if I change plans?
I need to downgrade because I'm not using all my data
Can I change from monthly to annual billing?

intents.name: Connectivity Issue
intents.description: Customer experiencing internet, network, or connection problems
exemplars: My internet has been cutting out all day
I can't connect to WiFi on any of my devices
The connection speed is way slower than what I'm paying for
I keep losing connection during video calls
My internet works fine in the morning but dies every evening

intents.name: Device Issue
intents.description: Customer has problems with hardware or device functionality
exemplars: My router keeps restarting on its own
The device won't turn on after the last update
My phone screen is frozen and won't respond to touch
The set-top box is showing a blinking red light
My device is overheating and shutting down

intents.name: Application Error
intents.description: Customer encounters errors in software or applications
exemplars: The app crashes every time I try to log in
I'm getting an error code 503 when I try to stream
The mobile app won't load my account information
I keep getting 'session expired' even though I just logged in
The app is stuck on a loading screen

intents.name: Service Outage
intents.description: Customer reports a service outage or asks about known issues
exemplars: Is there an outage in my area? Nothing is working
All my services went down at the same time
Your website says everything is fine but my service is completely out
How long until the outage is fixed?
This is the third outage this month

intents.name: Account Creation
intents.description: Customer wants to create a new account
exemplars: I'd like to set up a new account
How do I sign up for your service?
I want to create an account for my business
What do I need to open an account?
Can I create a family account with multiple users?

intents.name: Account Modification
intents.description: Customer wants to update account details
exemplars: I need to update my address on my account
Can I change the email associated with my account?
I want to add my spouse to my account
How do I update my payment method?
I need to change my account name due to a legal name change
I need to update my mailing address and phone number
Can I change my billing address on file?
I moved to a new house and need to update my account details

intents.name: Password Reset
intents.description: Customer needs help resetting or recovering password
exemplars: I forgot my password and can't log in
The password reset email never arrived
I need to reset my password but I don't have access to my old email
My account got locked after too many password attempts
How do I set up a new password?

intents.name: Cancellation
intents.description: Customer wants to cancel service or close account
exemplars: I want to cancel my subscription effective immediately
How do I close my account?
I'm switching to a competitor and need to cancel
Can I cancel without paying an early termination fee?
I want to cancel but keep my data for 30 days

intents.name: Product Inquiry
intents.description: Customer wants information about products or services
exemplars: What plans do you currently offer?
Tell me about your premium tier features
Do you offer any bundled packages?
What's the difference between the basic and pro plans?
Does your service work internationally?

intents.name: Upgrade Request
intents.description: Customer wants to upgrade their current plan or service
exemplars: I want to upgrade to the premium plan
Can I add more storage to my current plan?
What would it cost to upgrade to unlimited data?
I need more features than my current plan offers
Is there a discount if I upgrade for a full year?

intents.name: New Service
intents.description: Customer interested in adding new services
exemplars: I'd like to add home security to my package
Do you offer any add-on services?
I want to start a new line of service
Can I add international calling to my plan?
I'm interested in your new streaming service

intents.name: Pricing Information
intents.description: Customer wants pricing details or comparisons
exemplars: How much does the business plan cost?
Are there any current promotions?
What's your price match policy?
Can I get a discount for being a loyal customer?
How does your pricing compare to competitors?
